title: LargeValue
description: A value, or a whole image, a ledger tool left out because it is too large for the agent to read (CONTRACT.md, Large values). The value itself is stored in full: a revert runs from the stored rows, and the person reads it with the CLI.

in.description: Where the value was: a row image (KEY, BEFORE, AFTER on a change; KEY, NOW, SET on a revert line), the statement, or the parameters.

field.description: The field left out of the image. Absent when the whole image (or the statement, or the whole parameter list) was left out.

index.description: With in PARAMS: the 0-based index of a parameter over 1 MiB. The whole params array is then left out.

bytes.description: The size of the value's text in bytes: a JSON string's characters in UTF-8, any other value (and an image) its jsonb text, the statement its text.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of that same text, computed by Postgres.
